services.name: Handyman Services
services.description: Registered and insured home repairs, drywall, carpentry, doors, painting, punch-list work, and licensed-trade coordination across Pinellas County.

services.name: General Repairs
services.description: Drywall patching, trim repair, caulking, sealing, door adjustments, screens, punch-list corrections, and mixed repair work for Pinellas County homes.

services.name: Plumbing Services
services.description: Plumbing-related diagnosis, visible leak assessment, finish closeout and eligible handyman-scope maintenance. Work requiring licensed plumbing or potable-water connections is referred.

services.name: Electrical Work
services.description: Electrical issue assessment, bulb and cover-plate changes, eligible non-wiring work, and licensed-electrician coordination. Wiring, fixtures, fans, switches and outlets are referred.

services.name: Carpentry & Framing
services.description: Trim, shelving, framing repairs, subfloor corrections, custom carpentry, and structural woodwork support for residential repair projects.

services.name: Painting & Finishing
services.description: Interior paint touch-ups, texture matching, trim painting, room refreshes, and finish restoration after repairs in Pinellas County homes.

services.name: Home Renovations
services.description: Bathroom refreshes, flooring updates, tile work, room remodel support, and smaller renovation scopes for occupied Florida homes.

services.name: Doors & Windows
services.description: Door adjustments, locks/hardware, screens, weatherstripping and eligible maintenance. Full window-unit and new exterior-door replacement is referred when licensed work is required.

services.name: Custom Projects
services.description: Built-ins, custom shelving, accent walls, specialty installs, and one-off homeowner projects that need a dependable local handyman.

services.name: Urgent Property-Damage Response
services.description: Posted-hours and after-hours callback for unsecured openings, temporary weatherproofing, handyman-scope damage stabilization, storm follow-up, and licensed-trade coordination. Not a 24/7 dispatch service.
